nodes.label: MIRA: AI Scientist System
nodes.author: Deep Principle Team
nodes.rationale: MIRA operationalizes the scientific discovery loop end-to-end through three design choices: a squad of specialized agents, elastic cloud compute infrastructure, and integration with an automated laboratory (AI Materials Factory).

nodes.label: Agent Squad Architecture
nodes.rationale: Squad design mirrors human research team division of labor, with role-based specialization (supervising, generative, reflective, evolutionary, similarity-checking, synthesizing, simulation, experiment roles) rather than topic-based, enabling disagreement manufacturing through competing hypotheses.

nodes.label: Scientific Skills Layer
nodes.rationale: Curated procedural knowledge packaged as versioned skills encodes domain expertise (convergence criteria, pre-screening steps, parameter selection, validation procedures) that general-purpose models lack, ensuring dependability and comparability across runs.

nodes.label: MIRA Compute Platform
nodes.rationale: Cloud-native, AI-native execution layer with batch jobs and hosted inference services; designed for agent consumers rather than human operators, requiring idempotent submission, structured failure reporting, and self-delivering results.

nodes.label: AI Materials Factory
nodes.rationale: In-house automated laboratory for physical execution; sits behind same planning layer as calculations, enabling closed-loop synthesis and characterization where measurements return to the hypothesis-generation loop.

nodes.label: Memory and Scientific Wiki
nodes.rationale: Compilation layer (not retrieval) that maintains interlinked wiki pages with explicit cross-references and flagged contradictions; ingestion, querying, and linting operations keep knowledge alive; negative results and provenance persist as reusable assets.

nodes.label: OA-ReactDiff Model
nodes.author: Duan et al.
nodes.rationale: Object-aware equivariant diffusion model for direct transition-state geometry prediction from reactant and product structures, replacing expensive saddle-point searches and reducing cost of reaction-network exploration.

nodes.label: React-OT Model
nodes.author: Duan et al.
nodes.rationale: Deterministic optimal-transport map replacing stochastic sampling for transition-state generation, removing variance of repeated sampling and lowering per-structure cost.

nodes.label: YARP Reaction Enumeration
nodes.author: Zhao & Savoie
nodes.rationale: Methodology for reaction enumeration and network growth following systematic procedures for automated reaction prediction.

nodes.label: KHP Decomposition Pathway Prediction
nodes.rationale: Autonomous exploration of γ-ketohydroperoxide decomposition network; MIRA enumerated 78 candidate reactions in first layer, promoted three species, enumerated 58 more in second layer, yielding 59 species and 64 validated reactions recovering Korcek mechanism.

nodes.label: ABL1–Imatinib Binding Mode Prediction
nodes.rationale: Multi-candidate complex prediction with ESMFold2-fast, ranking by pLDDT/pTM/ipTM, binding-mode analysis via ProteinsPlus/PoseEdit/Protoss; three candidates converged on common binding mode with four hydrogen bonds and two π-stacking interactions.

nodes.label: CO Adsorption on Pt(111) Modeling
nodes.rationale: Surface science workflow combining MACE machine-learning optimization with ABACUS DFT relaxation; calculated adsorption energy of −1.817 eV, recovering atop site preference and charge redistribution patterns.

nodes.label: ResearchClawBench Evaluation
nodes.rationale: End-to-end research benchmark with 40 paper-grounded tasks across 10 domains; MIRA scored 17.51 on Chemistry/Energy/Materials subset, highest among seven agents at lowest cost ($0.67/task), dominating all alternatives on both score and cost.

nodes.label: SciAgentArena Drug Discovery Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Multi-institutional benchmark across five task categories (data preprocessing, analysis, molecule optimization, safety assessment, claim validation); MIRA achieved 81.1% overall, leading four of five categories and exceeding purpose-built agents by 11.9+ points.
